notes: The tuition figure of 178 euros/year appears on the Parcoursup page as the standard annual fee; the page also shows '178 euros + 118 euros' which may correspond to additional fees (e.g. CVEC). The fee is stated for students on this programme generally, not specifically for non-EU applicants. The programme is taught in French with English as a language option; the C1 French level is stated as required. No application channel is extracted for this programme, as instructed: foreign-diploma applicants apply through Etudes en France / Campus France.
